text:
jordan: Heads up — planning release v2.14.1 in 15m (kick at 2024-09-12 16:30 PT). I'll be the deploy owner. @alex standby for infra, @sam on smoke checks, @maria on logs/traces. Rollback plan: quick rollback script available. Brief checklist below. :eyes:

alex: ack I'll be on pager and watch canary groups + autoscaler.

sam: I'll run the smoke checklist once canary is live. Quick checks: curl health, run 100 synthetic requests, check 95/99 latencies.

maria: I'll enable extra log retention and tail error logs. If anything >0.5% errors in 5m, call rollback.

deploy-bot: BUILD_ARTIFACT deploy/v2.14.1 built by ci-pipeline at 2024-09-12T23:12:00Z

jordan: rolling canary to 5% then 25% then 100% with 5m watch at each step. If any check fails we rollback to v2.14.0. Runbook: /runbooks/deploy-rollback.md

sam: quick curl snippet I'll run:
```
for i in {1..100}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://api.redwood.ai/health; done
```

alex: starting canary now (5%). tagging with release: v2.14.1

deploy-bot: Canary at 5% — routing applied to hosts: model-svc-canary-01, api-canary-02

sam: smoke pass on basic health endpoints. 0/100 errors. p95=120ms p99=360ms. no obvious regressions. :thumbsup:

maria: I'm seeing a spike of 503s from model-serving-03 during step 2 (25% rollout). funneling to 503 logs. @alex can you look at model pool?

alex: confirmed model-serving-03 hitting OOM-ish logs. increasing pool size and pinning quantized variant for that host. scaling up GPU nodes by +1.

jordan: holding at 25% until we see stability. everyone monitor latency and error rate.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused (manual) at 25% — awaiting verifications

sam: reran 200 synthetic requests against canary group after scale: errors 2/200 transient, p95=140ms, p99=420ms. tracking, looks like warm-up behavior.

maria: traces show larger KV cache miss rate on that host, warming should reduce p99 in ~2 mins.

alex: cache warm completed, OOM messages stopped. adjusted Kubernetes resource requests.

sam: final quick-run: 0/200 errors, p95=110ms, p99=300ms. good to proceed. :white_check_mark:

jordan: proceeding to 100% rollout. will monitor for 15m after finish. rollback threshold: error_rate >0.5% sustained 5m or latency increase >2x p95.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete — v2.14.1 active

maria: watching dashboards — slight latency bump at 5m mark but within threshold. No alerts fired.

leo: added a smoke alert for model-availability and set automatic rollback to disabled (manual only) for this release per request.

sam: marking smoke checklist done. I'll open a tiny follow-up PR for the canary memory limits we tweaked.

alex: noted. will follow up with a patch to the autoscaler config.

jordan: thanks all. if nothing else in 20m I'll mark this as release-complete. :celebrate:

maria: fine by me. :thumbsup:

sam: done — marking in the release doc and closing the thread.
